stored_metadata.title: Run quality at a glance
stored_metadata.body: [MultiQC](https://multiqc.info) aggregates the per-sample [FastQC](https://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/fastqc/) and [Cutadapt](https://cutadapt.readthedocs.io) reports: read how many reads survived trimming, how evenly they spread across samples, and whether base quality holds to the end of the read. The other panels are folded into *QC details* below.

catalog_source.description: The one table every MultiQC report has: one row per sample, one column per headline metric each module contributed. Not a module's own output, which is why it names no producing tool — MultiQC assembles it from all of them.
Adapter/primer trimming summary (filtered reads, trimmed sequence lengths) — Cutadapt, surfaced via MultiQC.
Raw-read sequencing QC (per-base quality, GC content, duplication, adapter content) — FastQC plots aggregated by MultiQC.
